title: Sacut (Success Pond)
summary: Sacut is recorded as the Native name for Success Pond at Lakeville in North Hempstead.
history_content: The pond was formerly known as Success Pond. The source notes that Sacut may have shifted in sound into Success and cites nineteenth-century descriptions of the pond and its former outlet.
translation_content:
Sacut is interpreted as "at the outlet," from a word for the outlet of a pond or stream flowing out of a pond, with a locative ending meaning at or near.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place-names link us to the landscape, and by so doing give useful insight into a people’s traditional way of life.”

— Nna O. Uluocha, Decolonizing place-names: Strategic imperative for preserving indigenous cartography in post-colonial Africa (2015), Significance of toponyms, paragraph 3
preservation_content: Sacut links the modern Lake Success landscape with an older Native description of water movement and outlet geography.
